subject: Hiring sync: Senior Inference Engineer — role clarity, bar-raiser asks, candidate staging
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hiring sync: Senior Inference Engineer — role clarity, bar-raiser asks, candidate staging

Hi team,

We have Maria Lopez (Greenhouse 70123) moving into onsite interviews next week; I want to lock alignment on role scope and the specific assessment asks we want across interviews so the debrief is actionable and consistent.

Quick context: this hire is for the runtime/inference plane — focus is kernel selection, batching/cache strategies, memory/KV cache debugging, and production-grade latency/cost tradeoffs. We expect ownership across the serving runtime (compilation/kernel choices) and incident triage for production regressions. Leveling target: Senior (IC4) with potential stretch to IC5 for candidates who demonstrate system design + measurable shipping impact.

Please review the attached one-pager for the updated role scope (Sr_Inference_Req-Brief.pdf) and the draft debrief rubric (debrief_rubric_v2.docx). My asks:
- Markus: can you add two signature questions that probe "tradeoff reasoning" on quantization vs. kernel changes? Prefer short, measurable prompts (2–3 min to explain, then a follow-up micro-design).
- Marissa: please confirm bar-raiser availability for the afternoon debrief on 3/18 and slot in the canary interview for systems debugging (we need at least one deep KV-cache debugging session).
- Laura: can you own the candidate staging — confirm interviewers have the packet, and that resume+LGN notes are in the interview room. Also add a quick paragraph in the packet about what evidence satisfies a Senior vs. IC5 callout.

Candidate availability per recruiter: 3/17 any time except 10:30–11:15 PT; 3/18 AM only (until 11:30 PT). Prefer we keep the heavy systems interview on 3/17 and follow with behavioral + product on 3/18.

I'll collect final interview prompts by EOD today so we can publish a single interview packet for the panel.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sr_Inference_Req-Brief.pdf, debrief_rubric_v2.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring sync: Senior Inference Engineer — role clarity, bar-raiser asks, candidate staging

Thanks — quick answers and questions inline.

- I can take the tradeoff questions. Proposed two prompts: (a) "You need to reduce tail latency for long-sequence generation by 25% under same cost. Walk me through three architectural levers you would try, the risks, and how you'd validate each." (b) "Show how quantization affects KV cache and attention precision on an LLM decoder; what kernel-level optimizations might you prefer over quantizing, and why?"
- Each prompt should have a 12-minute slot: 6 minutes for explanation, 6 for follow-ups/mini-design. That gives us a clear scoring axis: clarity, practicality, validation strategy.

Question: do we want a short (5-min) whiteboard of profiling output for the systems slot? I can prepare a short synthetic profile for Maria to read and ask her to prioritize hotspots.

I'll add my questions to the rubric and send a doc link by noon.

— Markus
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachment: (will add questions to debrief_rubric_v2.docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Hiring sync: Senior Inference Engineer — role clarity, bar-raiser asks, candidate staging

All good from my side. Bar-raiser (R. Malhotra) confirmed 3/18 1:30–2:15 PT for debrief. I'll schedule the panel as: 3/17 9:00–11:30 PT for systems deep-dive (includes Markus), 3/17 2:00–3:00 PT product/system tradeoff, 3/18 9:00–11:00 PT behavioral + leadership.

I created a quick interview packet in Drive — link below. Laura, please add resume + interviewer notes to the "Candidate Staging" folder.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/InterviewPacket/SrInference

I'll also upload Maria's resume to Greenhouse and attach it to the candidate record.

— Marissa

Subject: Re: Hiring sync: Senior Inference Engineer — role clarity, bar-raiser asks, candidate staging

Thanks for the quick turn. Final notes before interviews tomorrow:

1) Interview packet published in Drive — all prompts live. Please use the rubric tabs: Evidence (what we expect), Signals (red/amber/green indicators), and Notes (one-line conclusion).
2) Debrief cadence: 30-minute synchronous debrief on 3/18 with bar-raiser present. Please come with 1–2 bullet examples of evidence you collected and a recommended hire/no-hire decision. The debrief doc includes a proposed decision matrix — feel free to edit.
3) Logistics: candidate will join the 9:00 PT room directly; Laura, you own the room setup and confirm screen-sharing for the profiling artifact Markus mentioned.

Good luck — and thanks for being crisp on evidence.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
